evidence.quote: we have indicated we can be patient as we assess what adjustments, if any, will be appropriate to the stance of monetary policy.
some indicators of longer-term inflation expectations remain at the low end of a range that I consider consistent with our price-stability mandate.
the incoming data have revealed signs that U.S. economic growth is slowing somewhat from 2018's robust pace.
the FOMC intends to slow the runoff of our securities starting in May and to cease the runoff entirely in September.
The U.S. economy is in a good place and operating close to both of the Federal Reserve's dual-mandate objectives of maximum employment and price stability.

parsed.rationale: The speech pairs a strong labor-market assessment with muted inflation, slowing growth, international risks, patience on rates and an early end to balance sheet runoff. Together these signal a moderately dovish pause.
